[[File:NedgarrBanditsHideoutInterior.jpg|200px|thumb|Trae Nedgarr with one of his bandits in the lower level of the bunker]]
The '''Nedgarr Bandits Hideout''' was a bunker on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] used by the criminal organization known as the [[Nedgarr Bandits]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was located in the [[Riverlands]], in a relatively short distance northeast of [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]]. Sometime following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the bandits had been responsible for damaging local [[Farm/Legends|farms]], such as [[Pol Handerin]]'s [[Pol Handerin's farm|farm]], and stealing [[Grain/Legends|grain]].<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Mack Jasper]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with disrupting their operations. The CorSec agent assaulted the Nedgarr Bandits Hideout and recovered the stolen grain. Within the lower level of the bunker, the spacer alo killed [[Trae Nedgarr]], leader of the bandits.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Nedgarr Bandits hideout was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The Nedgarr Bandits hideout was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> It was part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" /> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]," on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:HFPH" />
